reporting-org.narrative: European Bank for Reconstruction and Development

title.narrative: Green Cities 3 W2 - Yerevan Customs and Logistics Centre

description.narrative: The EBRD loan will support the establishment of a Customs and Logistics Centre ("CLC") near Yerevan ("Yerevan CLC") by financing the construction of a customs terminal and the acquisition of relevant equipment (the "Project"). The investment is expected to qualify for the Green building certification, resulting in Yerevan CLC, along with a similar centre in the Syunik region, one of the first two public buildings to attain such certification. The Yerevan CLC is expected to increase efficiency and transparency of customs operations, improve the quality, and reduce the time required for customs clearance services through the application of the "One Stop Shop / Single Window" concept. The Project also aims to promote human capital development and increase access to economic opportunities for the local population, by supporting the digitalisation of the State Revenue Committee's (the "SRC") customs certified programme and introducing dedicated training modules on data literacy and data software skills.
